basic_info.description: Luxurious and inviting updated studio ideal for full time city living, or the perfect pied-a-terre in a prime Potrero Hill location! The modern flat opens to a tastefully remodeled gourmet eat-in kitchen with shaker-style cabinets, quartz countertops, high-end appliances and an updated bathroom.  The open and inviting living area with recently installed recessed lighting and engineered wood flooring overlooks the well-maintained, mature grounds and landscaping along with the swimming pool and jacuzzi.  This elevator building offers a 21st century equipped gym, hot tub, swimming pool, clubhouse, outdoor BBQ, laundry, parking, and too many other amenities to list.  Do not miss this special flat that is close to world class dining and shops on 18th and 20th Street, parks, playgrounds, public transportation, HWY 101/280 and more!
